envelope.description: Register the inferParentCandidates daemon IPC method + mirror its type

body.title: Register the inferParentCandidates daemon IPC method + mirror its type
body.summary: Add a new additive daemon IPC method that exposes inferParentCandidates, wiring it into the daemon handler registry (src/daemon/index.ts). Mirror the request/response payload types to the IDE fork per the IPC lock-step rule. Additive only — no existing method signature changes. Guard the method behind the existing bugfixCategory feature flag where the registry supports flag-gating.
acceptanceChecks: The new IPC method is registered and dispatches to inferParentCandidates; no existing IPC method signature changes.
An UnregisteredRepoError propagates when repoPath is not in the registry (rule 6).
tsc clean; the mirrored payload type matches the daemon-side InferredCandidates shape.

tests.name: IPC method dispatches to inferParentCandidates and returns InferredCandidates; UnregisteredRepoError on an unregistered repoPath
